mapper.sql: transaction_id, account_id, transaction_type, amount, transacted_at, balance_after, source_provider, source_transaction_id, source_sequence
mapper.select: SELECT account_id FROM group_account WHERE account_id = #{accountId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO group_transaction (account_id, transaction_type, amount, transacted_at, balance_after, source_provider, source_transaction_id, source_sequence) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{transactionType}, #{amount}, #{transactedAt}, #{balanceAfter}, #{sourceProvider}, #{sourceTransactionId}, #{sourceSequence})
INSERT INTO transaction_anomaly_analysis (transaction_id, revision_no, input_fingerprint, status, quality_flags) VALUES (#{transactionId}, 1, #{fingerprint}, 'PENDING', JSON_ARRAY())
mapper.update: UPDATE transaction_anomaly_analysis SET status = 'COMPLETED', anomaly_score = #{result.anomaly_score}, threshold = #{result.threshold}, is_anomaly = #{result.is_anomaly}, cold_start = #{result.cold_start}, quality_flags = #{qualityFlags}, model_version = #{result.model_version}, feature_schema_version = #{result.feature_schema_version}, analyzed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), error_code = NULL WHERE transaction_id = #{transactionId} AND revision_no = 1 AND input_fingerprint = #{fingerprint} AND status = 'PENDING'
